title: Sequential Changes of Serum KL-6 Predict Progression in Interstitial Lung Disease
brief_summary: Interstitial lung disease is a chronic progressive fibrosis lung disease that with a highly variable clinical process.thence it is significant for the patient to search a convenient and accurate prediction method. The objective of this study was to determine whether peripheral blood biomarkers can predict disease .
